items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Manny' in a quote attributed to 'Manny' ('Manny said, "Give me that Conn horn, I'll trade you."'), but the interviewee (Teddy McRae) does not speak about a personal relationship with Manny, nor does he confirm he was the one interacting with Manny. The mention appears to be

ctx.x:
And Benny -- I think Beeny Waters we were
talking about at the time. So I decided when we
went to the Paramount, I was going to get me a
Selmer.

Went down to Manny's and the Selmers
had came in. And Manny said, "Give me that Conn horn,
I'll trade you."
